messages.author: afc045fc6160d53a
messages.subject: SockJSAdapter not loading
parts:
Hi there,

the Shiny-Server appears not to be able to load the SockJSAdapter during the starting process. We cannot see the corresponding processes using ps -axu on the command line.

root     29743  0.0  0.0 846260 36708 ?        Ssl  18:15   0:00 /opt/shiny-server/ext/node/bin/shiny-server /opt/shiny-server/lib/main.js --pidfile=/var/run/shiny-server.pid
michailk 29801  0.0  0.0  11928   920 pts/0    S+   18:35   0:00 grep shiny


On a similar system we have the following and here it works - Adapter loading as well as the shiny web service

root     31097  0.0  0.1 981432 58828 ?        Ssl  17:25   0:00 /opt/shiny-server/ext/node/bin/shiny-server /opt/shiny-server/lib/main.js --pidfile=/var/run/shiny-server.pid
root     31107  0.0  0.0 234852  5060 ?        Ss   17:25   0:00 su -s /bin/bash --login -p -- shiny -c R --no-save --slave -f \/opt\/shiny-server\/R\/SockJSAdapter\.R
shiny    31109  0.0  0.1 174188 50664 ?        Ss   17:25   0:01 /usr/local/lib/R-3.2.1/bin/exec/R --no-save --slave -f /opt/shiny-server/R/SockJSAdapter.R


Please help!

Lucia
